title: Blue Water Haven
meta_description: Find the perfect Watercolor, FL vacation rental at “Blue Water Haven”, a luxury 6-bed, 8-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 16 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Carriage House, Golf Cart & WaterColor amenities. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Newly Remodeled - Private Heated Pool (Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $50 per day) - Located in Watercolor's Park District - 6 Seater Golf Cart - 6 Adult Bikes Included - Fire pit - Access to community pools, nature trails, and dune lakes - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools (maximum number of 16 wristbands allotted). If wristbands are lost/not returned, there will be a $50 per wristband to replace. Welcome to Blue Water Haven! The Crown Jewel of Watercolor on 30A. Experience unparalleled lakeside luxury at this newly remodeled, three-story retreat, accommodating up to 16 guests, ideal for sophisticated family gatherings or elegant group getaways. Set on Western Lake, enjoy serene water views and breathtaking sunsets from sunrise to dusk. Begin your stay on the charming front porch swing or in the first-floor den with a sleek wet bar, opening to a screened porch with a gas fireplace. Outside, your private backyard sanctuary features a heated pool with a water feature, fire pit, BBQ, dining area, and ample seating for refined outdoor entertaining. The first floor hosts three King bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, two offering direct porch access. Upstairs, a luminous living room with a gas fireplace flows to a balcony and a gourmet chef’s kitchen with top-of-the-line appliances, complemented by an elegant dining area and half bath. The second-floor Master suite boasts a King bed, soaking tub, glass shower, dual vanities, and a sun-drenched sitting area overlooking the lake. The third floor offers a cozy lounge, three built-in full-size beds, and a full bathroom, while the two-story carriage house provides an additional luxurious retreat with a living area, kitchenette, King guest bedroom, full bath, and an upstairs playroom with lounge and game space. Blue Water Haven seamlessly combines sophistication, comfort, and lakeside elegance for an unforgettable escape. * Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 16 wristbands.* SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR Jr Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Combo King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Combo SECOND FLOOR Master King Bedroom, Private Bathroom w/ Shower/Tub separate Half Bathroom THIRD FLOOR Three Full Beds Bunkroom, w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only CARRIAGE HOUSE King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Combo
